name: Mama Sandra's Pupuseria
eyebrow: Honduran and Salvadoran food truck · Stamford, Connecticut
tagline: Honduran and Salvadoran food from a truck on East Main Street.
about: Mama Sandra's Pupuseria is a food truck at 1019 E Main St in Stamford serving Honduran and Salvadoran food. It also pops up at local breweries.
